notes.id: Uang gedung/SPI dan SPP Juli 2026 per program: DKV desain grafika Rp3.000.000 & Rp550.000 (dari Kudus) / Rp6.000.000 & Rp750.000 (luar Kudus); DKV teknik grafika Rp3.000.000 & Rp500.000; Animasi Rp4.000.000 & Rp650.000 (Kudus); PPLG/RPL Rp12.000.000 & Rp1.350.000 (luar Kudus). Uang gedung boleh lebih dari angka tertera. SPP sudah termasuk ujian, kunjungan industri, karya wisata; tidak ada iuran bulanan lain.
notes.en: Building fee and July 2026 tuition by programme: graphic design Rp3,000,000 & Rp550,000 (from Kudus) / Rp6,000,000 & Rp750,000 (outside Kudus); print technology Rp3,000,000 & Rp500,000; animation Rp4,000,000 & Rp650,000 (Kudus); software/game development Rp12,000,000 & Rp1,350,000 (outside Kudus). The building fee may be paid above the listed amount. Tuition includes exams, industry visits and trips; no other monthly charges.

source.title: Rincian Biaya Registrasi PMB TP 2026/2027 — SMK RUS Kudus (dokumen resmi)
